narrative: 一张脸是一张照片，墙壁是一幅画。
一则标题文字贴在玻璃上。当故事本身已经是一堆文件、广播画面和绘画的集合、剪辑若把它们抹平反而是一种谎言时使用它。
对于一个应当感觉像出自同一台摄影机、优雅统一的合成画面来说，这就用错了工具。如果每一层都是同一张静态图像撕碎而成，你更接近拼贴（Collage）。
如果唯一多出的一层只是作为物体存在的文字，你更接近动态文字（Typography）。
how: 用真实的主光拍摄或生成一层真人实拍画面。把插画、文字和素材资料作为独立图层加入，并保留可见的边界：撕裂、抠像，或直接拼接。
各媒介之间的光线不必匹配一致，这种不匹配正是不同来源的证据。
保留一个可辨识的主体，让这种碰撞有一个中心。提示词：mixed media around the subject: live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane。
when: 用在新闻、记忆和身体无法在同一种媒介上达成一致的那个段落。不要把它当作贴纸包，套用在一场依然渴望摄影化学统一感的戏上。
vs: 拼贴（Collage）把静态图像和材质叠加进同一张画面里；混合媒介则坚持在同一平面内呈现不同的采集方式。
动态文字（Typography）把文字作为世界中的物体放置；混合媒介可以包含文字，但文字只是相互碰撞的来源之一。
examples_film: 《天生杀人狂》（Natural Born Killers）把广播画面、电影胶片和图形插入碰撞在一起；《瞬息全宇宙》（Everything Everywhere All at Once）在宇宙无法固定于同一种媒介时，让插画、素材资料和真人实拍共享同一个平面。
这是语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是一张经过调色的真人实拍静帧上面加一个字体，或者一张单纯的拼贴画。破绽是只有一种质感、一种颗粒、一种打光方式。
解决办法是至少两种采集方式、可见的边界，以及一个可辨识的主体。

faq.q: 电影中的混合媒介是什么？
faq.a: 混合媒介把真人实拍与文字、插画和素材资料结合在同一个平面上，没有哪一种媒介独占画面的真实性。

faq.q: 混合媒介 vs 拼贴
faq.a: 拼贴是静态图像和材质的分层叠加；混合媒介是不同采集方式的碰撞：一张照片挨着一幅画，旁边再挨着文字。一个是撕碎的纸张，另一个是撕裂的本体。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用混合媒介？
faq.a: 当文件、广播画面和身体无法归结为同一张照片时使用它。如果这场戏依然需要单一摄影机的真实感，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写混合媒介的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Mixed media around [Subject], live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane"。列出具体媒介，并保留它们各自的边界；不要把它们融合成同一种调色。

narrative: A face is a photograph. The wall is a drawing.
A headline sits on the glass. Use it when the story is already a pile of documents, broadcasts, and drawings, and the cut would lie by smoothing them.
It is the wrong tool for a single elegant composite that should feel like one camera. If every layer is the same still torn into pieces, you are closer to collage.
If the only extra layer is words as objects, you are closer to typography.
how: Shoot or generate a live-action plate with a real key. Add illustration, type, and stock as separate layers with visible edges: torn, keyed, or butted.
Lighting does not have to match across media. The mismatch is evidence of different sources.
Keep one subject readable so the collision has a center. Prompt mixed media around the subject: live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane.
when: Use it for the beat when news, memory, and the body cannot agree on one medium. Do not use it as a sticker pack on a scene that still wants photochemical unity.
vs: Collage layers stills and textures into one picture. Mixed media insists on different capture modes in the same plane.
Typography puts words in the world as objects. Mixed media can include type, but type is only one of the colliding sources.
examples_film: Natural Born Killers collides broadcast, film, and graphic interruption. Everything Everywhere All at Once lets illustration, stock, and live action share a plane when the universe will not stay one medium.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a graded live-action still with a font on top, or a pure Collage of one photo. The tell is one texture, one grain, one key.
The fix is at least two capture modes, edges showing, one readable subject.

faq.q: What is mixed media in film?
faq.a: Mixed media combines live action with type, illustration, and stock in one plane. No single medium owns the truth of the frame.
Collage is layers of stills and textures. Mixed media is different capture methods colliding: a photograph next to a drawing next to type. One is torn paper. The other is torn ontology.

faq.q: When should I use mixed media?
faq.a: Use it when documents, broadcasts, and bodies cannot be one photograph. Skip it when the scene still wants a single camera's truth.

faq.q: How do I prompt mixed media for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Mixed media around [Subject], live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane. Name the media and keep their edges. Do not melt them into one grade.
